metadata.title: Google Pushes New AI Chips. Why There Could Be an Opening.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Google Pushes New AI Chips. Why There Could Be an Opening.
Google on Monday unveiled two new variants of its in-house artificial-intelligence chips. The push comes just as market leader Nvidia is grappling with an investigation into reports that its CEO Jensen Huang was targeted by a foreign intelligence effort.
